messages:
sophia: Heads-up — I'm kicking off a small project to produce a compatibility matrix and CI checks for our Terraform modules across cloud marketplaces + hardware variants (x86, Graviton, Ampere). Goal: a single CSV + README that partners and QE can use.
kevin: Nice. Can we scope this to: AWS Marketplace, GCP Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, and a generic on-prem flow? Also include dedicated/private network patterns?
hannah: yes to all. Also call out where modules need provider blocks keyed by region/instance type. We should document known incompatibilities (e.g., plugin version, AMI families, instance type naming differences).
raj: Proposal for deliverables:
- compat-matrix.csv (rows: module, cloud, arch, tested-image, terraform-version, notes)
- examples/aws-graviton.tf and examples/azure-arm64.tf
- GitHub Actions job that runs `terraform init && terraform validate` against a minimal plan for each target
- README with troubleshooting and sample outputs
sophia: I'll create the repo layout under partners/terraform-compat:
```
partners/terraform-compat/
  matrix/compat-matrix.csv
  examples/aws-graviton.tf
  examples/gcp-arm64.tf
  ci/.github/workflows/compat-check.yml
  README.md
```
kevin: For the CI job, local plan/apply won't be possible for Marketplace AMIs. Suggest running `terraform validate` + `tflint` + a lightweight plan using provider `-target` on networking resources only. Also include `TF_LOG=TRACE` option for failing runs to capture provider errors.
hannah: Add a step to verify instance type strings by regex, e.g., validate aws_instance.instance.instance_type against allowed list for arm64: [a1, m6g, c6g, r6g, t4g]
raj: Example of a minimal verify step we can put in GH Actions:
```
- name: Validate TF
  run: |
    terraform init -backend=false
    terraform validate
    tflint --config .tflint.hcl || true
    python tools/check_instance_types.py examples/metadata.json
```
sophia: I'm going to draft the CSV header and a first-pass row for our core refarch module (llm-serving):
module,cloud,arch,tested_image,terraform_version,notes
llm-serving,aws,arm64,ami-0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b,1.5.7,works with gp4dn-like families; needs vendor kernel argument

kevin: Where will we store validated AMI IDs? We should avoid hardcoding AMIs in examples; use a lookup file per-region that CI can refresh via an AWS account with read-only perms.
hannah: Agree. Use a small script `tools/resolve_amis.py` that queries SSM parameter store or a curated JSON in the repo owned by partner-eng.
raj: Ownership and schedule:
- sophia: create repo scaffold + initial CSV by Mon (assign)
- kevin: CI job and GH Actions template (this week)
- hannah: validation scripts + instance-type checker (end of week)
- raj: coordinate with partner QE for marketplace AMI smoke tests (next week)
sophia: tagging: @kevin @hannah assigning PR requests. I'll add an initial issue with checklist and link to the internal marketplace onboarding doc.
ci-bot: ci-bot has created branch `compat/initial-scaffold` and added default CODEOWNERS entry for `/matrix` -> @sophia
kevin: Quick note — when we add Azure examples, call out SKU families and offer a fallback to `Standard_D2s_v3` if arm64 SKUs aren't available in a region.
hannah: Also include a section in README on quantization/optimization flags that differ by architecture (e.g., CPU affinity, jemalloc tuning, and NVME ephemeral storage configs).
sophia: Great. I'll open the initial PR and ping the partners channel for review. If anyone wants to pair on the GH Actions YAML tomorrow, I'm free 10–11am PST.
kevin: I'll join 10:15. :+1:
hannah: I'll be there. :rocket:
sophia: Thanks team — will update thread with PR link and matrix CSV when ready.
